entries.summary: Offline-capable phone and computer web app built on fm1-emu that plays any Firmware Hub firmware on a touch FM-1, takes a MIDI keyboard, and installs firmware on a real FM-1 over USB after a backup and the m-bootloader…

entries.name: fm1-rust
entries.summary: Bare-metal Rust board support crate for the FM-1 on embedded-hal 1.0, with no allocator and three example firmwares: a blinking LED, a colour test card and a square-wave tone.

entries.name: FM-1 STM32 Unbrick
entries.summary: STM32F4DISCOVERY firmware that puts an FM-1 that shows no USB device into its chip's ROM boot mode with USB cables only, so a computer script can back up the flash and rewrite the firmware area with official V15.

entries.name: Burger Studio
entries.summary: Android groovebox app built to play alongside the FM-1 over USB MIDI, with a step sequencer for samples, drum pads, bass and analog synth parts, a vocal channel, song parts and mix recording.

entries.name: FMutate cartridges
entries.summary: Build pipeline and signed release feed that compile FM-1 Firmware Hub firmwares from their own source into native Android and iOS cartridges for the FMutate app.

entries.name: MASHINA
entries.summary: Live sound-module firmware for the FM-1 that follows JIANT LIVE DRUMS: six tracks on their own MIDI channels with keyboard zones, 32 MIDI CC macros, two 12-sound drum engines, extra synth engines and no song sequencer.

entries.name: MB-1
entries.summary: Minibrute-style monophonic synth for the FM-1 with Ultrasaw, PWM and Metalizer oscillators, a resonant multimode filter with Brute Factor, two ADSRs, an LFO, an arpeggiator and a browser emulator.

entries.name: METRONOME
entries.summary: Stage metronome with sixteen songs on the white keys, each with its own tempo, meter, step pattern and sound, a web setlist editor, and a live page that follows the unit over USB or Bluetooth.

entries.name: Mighty Arcade
entries.summary: Eighteen casual games for the FM-1 that each double as a generative sequencer, from chess, solitaire and pinball to golf, pool and a worm, using Mighty Arp's sound engine, with a browser emulator.

entries.name: PING OS-1
entries.summary: Four-track rhythm synthesis engine with 49 synthesized drum models, 20 synth models, 23 effects, a step sequencer with parameter locks, a line generator and an autopilot that varies a playing pattern.

entries.name: POLY5
entries.summary: Five-synth firmware on Dinghy: notes go round robin, at random, to all five or to one, with 24 factory patches, an arpeggiator, a step sequencer, lofi tape effects and eight master effects.

entries.name: TastyWaves plugin
entries.summary: VST3 and CLAP plugin in Rust that runs the TastyWaves wavetable firmware's synth core in a DAW, with 22 automatable parameters and an interface drawn like the FM-1.

entries.name: Tether
entries.summary: Turns the FM-1 into a USB MIDI controller and into the front panel of the FM1.Pocket browser emulator: keys, knobs and buttons play the page, and the page's screen and lights show on the unit.

entries.name: Vostok
entries.summary: Felucca-based firmware for the FM-1 and SMK-37 that adds a VOSTOK sound engine with 68 factory sounds, a Soviet space-programme theme, a pseudo-Cyrillic interface and a browser emulator.

entries.name: Windjammer
entries.summary: Skiff-derived FM-1 firmware that turns the unit into a native controller and display for a phone or computer app, which runs the sequencer and synth engines over USB MIDI and an open protocol.

entries.name: eurorack-mi-sgnir
entries.summary: Slim source tree for the Rings firmware at a pinned upstream commit, with frequency locking, octave snapping on the frequency knob and a stricter calibration gesture; a Schliere allpass-chain mode is planned.

entries.name: Vibe Machine
entries.summary: Homebrew pocket synth and groovebox for the 3DS built on the AMY library, with Juno-6 and DX7 patch banks, original engines, a 16-step sequencer, performance effects and a four-track tape recorder.

entries.name: lsdj-album
entries.summary: Builds a stand-alone Game Boy album ROM from the songs in an LSDj save, with a custom logo, song names, a level-meter and waveform visualizer and next and previous song buttons.
